_about: Every word a reader sees or hears in LibreSpydus (iOS and Android), applying docs/native-apps.md §7.1. Edit here, then run design/scripts/gen_copy.py. A leaf is a string with {named} placeholders, {"one", "other"} for a plural on {count}, or {"ios", "android"} where the platform convention differs. {count} is an Int (shown with the locale's digit grouping); every other placeholder is a String. Keys starting with _ are notes, not copy.

_notes.viewAll: The one title-case exception besides the names (§7.1 style).
_notes.loading: Screen-reader label of a spinner or skeleton with no visible text.
_notes.selected: Screen-reader label of the checkmark on a chosen menu item (Android menus).

_notes.myPicks: Was 'Favourites' in both apps' tab bar.

_notes.labelAndHint: Android only. Compose has no hint, and TalkBack reads an onClickLabel as 'Double-tap to <label>', so a third-person hint ('Opens Profile') goes after the label in contentDescription, as FeaturedRow already does. Use onClickLabel / customActions only for imperative action names (Edit reservation, Remove from My Picks, More options).
_notes.updating: Appended to a reservation card's label while its cancel/edit runs.
_notes.refreshing: Your Books status line while a refresh runs: 'Updated 3 min ago. Refreshing'.
